description: Replace a day note's text and/or move it to another day, by note id (from journal_get_day or journal_search_notes). The body is replaced whole — to append, read the current text first and send the full new version. Trade notes are edited with journal_update_trade, not here. Returns the updated note. Requires signing in with a LuxAlgo account (OAuth).

date.description: Move the note to this day, YYYY-MM-DD in the journal timezone.

name: journal_update_note
title: Update a journal note
